decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - 2.	The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  023-PE-BB-0101 Rev P05, 023-PE-BB-00-DR-A-0001 Rev P05, 023-PE-BA-ZZ-DR-A-0802 Rev P03, 023-PE-BA-ZZ-DR-A-0801 Rev P07, 023-PE-BA-00-DR-A-0050 Rev P02, 023-PE-00-99-DR-A-9901 Rev P02, 023-PE-00-99-DR-A-1501 Rev P02, Transport statement ref: NM/JM/GM/ITL9025-017A R, Design and Access Statement Issue 01, 023-PE-BB-ZZ-DR-A-0801 Rev P03 (received 22/03/2014) BREEAM Design Stage Report Issue 01 (received 14/05/2014) Block B energy statement (received 17/04/2014), Block A energy statement (received 24/06/2014), PL112, (received  08/07/2014) PL111, 398/100, 398/900 (received 01/08/2014) Arboriculture Constraints Report (received 12/08/2014) and PL650 rev A, PL651 rev A, PL652 rev A and PL653 rev A received on 23 May 2016 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - 3.	A travel plan shall be submitted and approved by the Local Planning Authority prior to the occupation of the development.  The measures contained in the Travel Plan shall be implemented as approved.

Condition : 4 - The electronic car charging points shall be installed in accordance with the approved details with reference to 00724/D/P3(4,5) dated 20/10/2014 or as otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority

Condition : 5 - 5.	Cycle parking shall be installed in accordance with the approved details with reference to 00724/D/P3(4,5) dated 20/10/2014 or as otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The development shall be carried out and used in accordance with the Delivery and Servicing Plan and Construction Logistics Plan submitted with the application.

Condition : 7 - Prior to the completion of both stages of development or within 1 year of the date of this decision, whichever is sooner, a BREEAM Final (Post-Construction) Certificate, issued by the BRE (or equivalent accredited body), must be submitted to the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that a Good rating has been achieved. All the measures integrated shall be retained for as long as the development is in existence.

Condition : 8 - Prior to the completion of both stages of development or within 1 year of the date of this decision, whichever is sooner, evidence shall be submitted demonstrating that a 25% reduction in carbon emissions above 2010 building regulations has been achieved in accordance with the energy statement.

Condition : 9 - 9.	In this condition "retained tree" means an existing tree which is to be retained in accordance with the approved plans and particulars; and paragraphs (a) and (b) below shall have effect until the expiration of (5 years?) from (the date of the occupation of the building for its permitted use).

(a)	No retained tree other than tree P4 shown on drawing 398/500 received on 23 May 2016 shall be cut down, uprooted or destroyed, nor shall any retained tree be topped or lopped other than in accordance with the approved plans and particulars, without the written approval of the local planning authority.  Any topping or lopping approved shall be carried out in accordance with British Standard[3998 (Tree Work)] or any other BS replacing.

(b)	If any retained tree other than tree P4 shown on drawing 398/500 received on 23 May 2016 is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, another tree shall be planted at the same place and that tree shall be of such size and species, and shall be planted at such time, as may be specified in writing by the local planning authority.

(c)	The erection of fencing for the protection of any retained tree shall be undertaken in accordance with the approved plans and particulars before any equipment, machinery or materials are brought on to the site for the purposes of the development, and shall be maintained until all equipment, machinery and surplus materials have been removed from the site.  Nothing shall be stored or placed in any area fenced in accordance with this condition and the ground levels within those areas shall not be altered, nor shall any excavation be made, without the written consent of the local planning authority.

Condition : 10 - 10.	Boundary treatment shall be installed in accordance with the approved details with reference to 00724/D/P3(10,11) dated 20/10/2014 or as otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 11 - 11.	Hard and soft landscaping shall be installed in accordance with the approved details with reference to 00724/D/P3(10,11) dated 20/10/2014 or as otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 12 - 12.	Refuse storage shall be installed in accordance with the approved details with reference to 00724/D/P3(12) dated 20/10/2014 or as otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 13 - The building shall be constructed in accordance with the materials approved with reference to 00724/D/P3(13) dated 20/10/2014 or as otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority
description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans), 7 (BREEAM Final Certificate) vary the wording of the condition from Prior to first occupation to Upon completion of both phases of the development, condition 8 (Carbon Emissions) vary the condition from a 40% reduction in carbon emissions to 25% and condition 9 (Trees) removal of tree in the courtyard following planning permission 00724/D/P3 approved 12/08/14 for erection of single storey front, side and rear extensions and the erection of a two storey side extension, increase in height of existing roof over new hall
